senses.gloss:
SESAME, SESAMUM, s. (The plant or seed) तिलः, सारालः, सुबन्धः,
दलाढकः, पूतधान्यं, हौम्यधान्यं; ‘its blossom,’ वज्रपुष्पं; ‘barren
sesamum, bearing no blossom, &c.,’ तिलपिञ्जः, तिलपेजः;
‘sown with sesamum, as a field. &c.,’ तिल्यः -ल्या -ल्यं, तैलीनः
-नी -नं; ‘oil of sesamum,’ तिलतैलं, तिलरसः, तिलस्रेहः, तैलं;
‘ground sesamum,’ तिलचूर्णं, तिलकल्कं, तिलकटः; ‘sediment
after the oil is expressed,’ तिलकिट्टं; ‘burnt offering of
sesamum,’ तिलहोमं; ‘sesamum made up in the shape of
a cow,’ तिलधेनुः f.; ‘sesamum seeds with water,’ तिलोदकं;
‘with milk and rice,’ तिलौदनं; ‘made of sesamum,’ तिल-
मयः -यी -यं.
ŚESHA, s. (King of the serpents), see SNAKE.

SESSION, s. (Sitting) उपवेशः -शनं.
— (Of a court or assembly)
सभा.
— (Time or term during which an assembly sits or
transacts business) सभा, सभाकालः, सभाकार्य्यकालः, कार्य्यनि-
र्वाहकालः.
ZEST, s. रुचिः f., स्वादः, आस्वादः, अभिरुचिः f. See RELISH.
